  Scenario: AC10 A role without Documents R is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a user with role RW-CAPACITY and no Documents right
    Given case "RW-2026-000123" is in that user's scope
    When the user opens the checklist of the case
    Then the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-002
    Then no checklist item list is returned

  Scenario: AC11 A case outside the user's scope is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a user whose scope does not include case "RW-2026-000456"
    When the user opens the checklist of case "RW-2026-000456"
    Then the system refuses the request with 403 and MSG-P4-003
    Then no item list is returned

  Scenario: AC12 The rwb-case contract does not answer inside the 2 s budget (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer within 2 s for case "RW-2026-000789"
    When CaseStateChanged moves that case to stage "LITIGATION"
    Then no case_document_check flag is written
    Then the event is retried
    Then after the retry limit the event goes to rwb.document.events.v1.dlt with the platform administrator as owner
